notes.title: From Horror To... Street Cleaning?
notes.content:
Dear Quantum Sleeper Community,
From the dark corridors of horror to the warmly lit streets of tomorrow - we're taking quite a turn with our next game: [b][url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3394420/Sweep_City/]Sweep City![/url] [/b]

After keeping you on the edge of your seat with Quantum Sleeper's LIDAR, we decided to try something completely different. Trade in your fear for a street sweeper, and instead of running from darkness, help us clean up the future!
What to expect in Sweep City:

[list]
[*] Cruise through a sci-fi city in your street sweeper cleaning up road trash and muck
[*] Fish weird treasures out of the trash
[*] Help the locals (none of them are trying to eat you this time)
[*] Get lost in the glow of street lamps on rain-soaked autumn streets
[*] Trick out your sweeper with upgrades, custom paint jobs and cabin comfort
[*] Chill to your own tunes with the in-cab music player while you work
[/list]

We know this is a weird jump from horror. But sometimes you just want to make a game about cleaning up the future and finding gold fish in puddles.

Want to try it early? We're looking for playtesters! Or Already convinced? Chuck it on your wishlist:
→ [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3394420/Sweep_City/]https://store.steampowered.com/app/3394420/Sweep_City/[/url]

Jump into our discord for more development updates and info about the game!
discord.gg/e2MkzwtYUV


P.S. The street sweeper's headlights are way brighter than the Flash Light ever was

notes.title: Build 1.0.4
notes.content:
Hello Players!

We've added several new features and improvements based on your feedback:

[b]New Features:[/b]
[list]
[*] Environmental voice echo - your microphone input now echoes realistically in the game world
[*] New achievement for completing a No Death Run
[*] Enhanced environmental audio and events
[*] Improved objective clarity and early-game navigation markers
[/list]

[b]Bug Fixes:[/b]
[list]
[*] Fixed microphone capture settings occasionally reactivating
[*] Fixed server room save point visual blending issues
[*] Corrected hand rotation when switching from flashlight to throwable items
[*] Resolved fog pop-in issue in affected room
[*] Fixed keycard grab animation
[/list]

notes.title: Build 1.0.3
notes.content:
Hello Players!

Based on some player feedback we have a list of additions and fixes for this build

[list]
[*] Added a Noise Gate to microphone, configurable in audio settings
[*] Added flash light palm grip when close to objects. 
[*] Flashlight aims at center of screen now
[*] Improved player fairness of the control room save point, previously the door often triggered the Ai to come running
[*] Added floor numbers in main stair well, fixed some missing signs
[*] Reduced door loudness for ai detection
[*] Increased flashlight light radius
[*] Balanced flashlight brightness so it doesn't over expose close up
[*] Improved color balance and brightness in lidar view to fix problems with too bright or too much bloom in dense point areas
[*] Increased distant point brightness slightly
[*] Added grab animation to clarify when things have been picked up or interacted
[*] Objectives for keycards show the ones you have and don't have
[*] Changed color of control room interfaces to show up better in headset
[*] Ai can hear fans in server room ¬‿¬
[*] Improved Ai pathing for hearing things around corners
[*] clarified wording of some UI prompt's and objectives
[*] Removed timeout of Intro text, now shows H to continue until pressed.
[*] Reduced resistance on stepping into `redacted`
[*] Adjustments to some map elements

[/list]

notes.title: Build 1.0.1
notes.content:
Big thank you to all the people that have played so far! Based on the feedback we have made a few additions and fixes.

Fixes and additions for this patch
[list]
[*] Option to change scanner toggle to holding of the button instead to give a more Painting feel.
[*] Added `Echos` into the facility. 
[*] Added Square Scanning mode, can cycle through modes with the assigned button. Square mode allows you to scan down to a fine point.
[*] Closed off alternate path on sublevel 1, have to go through room with scan probe instead.
[*] Reduced voxel grid size for the scan effect.
[*] Fixed no collision on console in control room.
[*] Fixed being able to pickup a thrown scan ball.
[*] Fixed seeing floating body on starting game or loading.
[*] Fixed `redacted` from not spinning (General wants it to spin) 
[*] Fixed typo in introduction.
[*] Made introduction text stay for longer.
[/list]

notes.title: Quantum Sleeper Available Now!
notes.content:
We're thrilled to announce that version 1.0 of our game is officially live and ready to play!
Release Patch Notes



Release Patch Notes:
Resolved AI behavior issue occurring during certain save conditions.
Fixed AI behavior inconsistencies between levels.
Updated various settings descriptions for better clarity.
Addressed gamepad navigation issues in the UI.
Added new story elements and flavor details to the map.

Known Issues:
On Steam Deck , the splash video shows as a test screen due to codec missing.
